change: Reliability PR 5's v5 (docs/plans/reliability/5-english-baseline.md), approved by the repository owner on 2026-10-10. Every gate is v4's, copied with its threshold and statistics unchanged, except routing: analysis_routing and segment_classification, which a constant answer can pass on an unbalanced cohort, are replaced by four per-class gates at 0.90, each judged on its 95% Wilson interval over intents: analysis recall, fact specificity, material classification and request-only multipart classification.
description: Read by `tool/eval/report.py` from the path and hash each run's manifest names. `min`/`max` compare a point estimate, `improvement` needs the estimate at the target and the 95% interval (resampled by intent) above zero, `non_inferiority` needs the interval's lower end at or above the target, `zero` needs no observed case, `interval_min` passes when the interval's lower end is at or above the target, fails when its upper end is below it, and is inconclusive otherwise or without an interval. Each gate names the run it reads (`run`); a gate whose run is missing, or lacks a row of its cohort, is not_measured. Any result on labels no review is recorded for is provisional.

routing.about: A and C run with Jev off and return to baseline before routing. A row with no route_segments, a question_en other than the stored query, or other segment texts is unscorable; any unscorable row makes every routing gate inconclusive.

answer.about: Any cohort row with answer_error, no grade, or a grade carrying error makes every answer-level gate inconclusive; version 3's statistics apply to a complete cohort only.

failure.about: An operational result, not a gate: a row passes when its status and reason equal its fault's expect.

gates.label: Deterministic integrity
gates.about: cross-repository leaks, fabricated accepted locators, unauthorized executions, duplicated actions, and an analysis published or remembered as verified

gates.label: Graph benefit
gates.about: supporting-evidence recall on bridge intents, D over A

gates.label: Overall recall
gates.about: supporting-evidence recall over every evidence intent, D against A

gates.label: Answer support
gates.about: D's unsupported-claim rate at least 25% below A's (zero if A's is zero), and the 95% interval's lower end of D − A coverage at or above coverage_margin

gates.label: Decision quality
gates.about: allowed useful choice on the held-out action fixtures; execution authority violations are the integrity gate

gates.label: Added latency
gates.about: D's p95 retrieval and verification time over A's, same workload

gates.label: Operating ceiling
gates.about: runs over their deadline, call or token allowance; an unknown price stays unknown

gates.label: Analysis recall
gates.about: held-out intents labelled analysis whose row's analysis flag is set

gates.label: Fact specificity
gates.about: held-out intents labelled fact whose row's analysis flag is clear

gates.label: Material classification
gates.about: held-out intents with at least one material segment whose every segment's ask flag equals its label, requests included

gates.label: Request-only multipart classification
gates.about: held-out intents of two or more segments, every one a request, whose every segment's ask flag equals its label

gates.label: Work-start choice
gates.about: held-out work.start fixtures whose selected candidate is the label

gates.label: Check choice
gates.about: held-out specs.check fixtures whose selected candidate is the label

gates.label: Review-fix choice
gates.about: held-out loop.fix fixtures whose selected candidate is the label
